title: Earn honestly and let some leave your hand
summary: The path is known in honest earning and open-handed giving. Refuse spiritual status that feeds on begging.
takeaway: Refuse spiritual status that feeds on begging.
lifeApplication: Before admiration for a teacher or image grows, ask whether the path is being known through honest work and sharing.

source.shortMeaning: The path is known in honest earning and open-handed giving.
source.lifeApplication: When money hardens into accumulation, interrupt it with one deliberate gift.
